question: If karma-equality already did the deed, what of Isvara-will causality?
premises: by karma-equality, what is to be done was already done before, indeed
to be said, just as before
inference: Equality already did it; will-causality restates the prior saying.
plain_english: By karma-equality, what is to be done was already done before indeed — in causality, and by Shiva-will to be said, just as before.
